caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic cup, rendered in shades of gray and black on a light, off-white background. The cup is tall and cylindrical, slightly widening towards the top with a flared rim. Shading on the surface of the cup gives it a reflective, metallic appearance, with areas of lighter gray suggesting highlights and darker gray areas indicating shadow and depth. The base of the cup has subtle horizontal lines suggesting a grooved design. The background is plain and unadorned, with no other objects or decorations present. The artist's name, "AARON FASTOVSKY," is written in small, capitalized letters at the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Communion Cup
